s: Mess Sergeant Ramsey's Cooking Supplies Shop
tx:
▸ From stores
For members, they can buy 500 from Khazard General Store and deposit it in the nearby Bank deposit box.
For free players, Mess Sergeant Ramsey's Cooking Supplies Shop is quite close to the Taverley bank, and has 500 stocked. Wydin's Food Store (also 500) is the next best option, as it is very close to the Port Sarim lodestone; you could then bank with ring of kinship or Archaeology journal.
▸ From player-owned house
Both oak larders (requires 33 Construction to build) and teak larders (requires 43 Construction) built in a player-owned house can provide unlimited pots of flour (among other ingredients) for free. Empty pots are not required, which makes this the one of the fastest methods of acquiring unlimited flour (if players want less than 500 pots of flour, using the Khazard General Store and bank deposit box is quicker), other than buying in bulk from other players, provided that players use teleports to bank. The biggest downside of this method is its tediousness, as players can only take one pot of flour at a time and it takes a little while as the game processes the commands. Spam clicking the larder while simultaneously hitting the 4 key greatly speeds the process.
It is also possible to take advantage of a sink to make dough on the spot. If players place an empty pot on the action bar, they can drop the pots quickly to make more space.
▸ From a windmill
Flour is ground-up wheat, which can be picked from a wheat field (size irrelevant due to its fast respawn), often found near a windmill. An empty pot is required to collect the flour.
• One of the best spots for members is the field North of Ardougne, which is very close to a bank and a mill.…

tx:
Players can obtain a vial of water in several ways:
• Members can use Humidify to make all the vials in their backpack to be filled with water.
• By using an empty vial on a water source other than a well.
• Take vials action on a portable well.
Players with the ability to access all the shops that supply vial of water packs can obtain 6,600 vials of water through visiting every shop, for a modest cost of 66k. This method requires very little effort. The individual vials sell for coins each on the Grand Exchange, resulting in a profit of coins per run.
Free players can buy limited amounts from Jatix's Herblore Shop in the eastern part of Taverley.
▸ Tactics for refilling
The Grand Exchange provides an exceptionally short run from one of the bankers to the fountain in the middle.
Fort Forinthry has Copperpot, a banker, right beside a well, which requires building the first tier of the Town Hall built.
For non-members, an old style hand pump just north of the west bank in Falador provides only a short running distance. Members may find that both the geyser in Neitiznot and the sink in the cellar of Lumbridge Castle are great places to refill vials with water due to close proximity to a bank and one-click banking chests. 
The best low-level member spot are the fountains at the bank entrance in Merchant District of Menaphos. Higher level members may also use the water pool located in the Meilyr section of Prifddinas if one does not wish to purchase directly from Lady Meilyr.
sc: A vial of water can be made by using a vial on a water source, or buying it from a store, a player or the Grand Exchange.
